gearbalance.config.title: GearBalance Settings
gearbalance.config.note: Green = saved, yellow = not saved yet. Applies after a restart.
gearbalance.stat.durability.tip: How many uses the item lasts (1 to 10000).
gearbalance.stat.damage.tip: Total damage, as shown in the item tooltip.
gearbalance.stat.speed.tip: Attacks per second as shown in the tooltip (sword 1.6, axe 0.8 to 1.0, spear 0.87 to 1.54).
gearbalance.stat.mining.tip: Added to the mining speed, similar to Efficiency. 0 = vanilla.
gearbalance.stat.armor.tip: Armor points (half an armor icon per point, 30 at most).
gearbalance.stat.toughness.tip: Armor toughness. Helps against strong hits (diamond 2, netherite 3).
gearbalance.stat.knockback.tip: 0 to 1. Netherite has 0.1 per piece (1 = no knockback).
gearbalance.stat.shield_disable.tip: Seconds the shield can't be used after an axe hit. 0 = never disabled. Shield only.
gearbalance.stat.shield_block.tip: How many percent of the damage from the front the shield blocks. 100 = vanilla. Shield only.
gearbalance.options.enabled.tip: Off: every item has its vanilla values again (applies after a restart) and every function is switched off (applies at once). Your settings stay saved.
gearbalance.options.set_bonuses.tip: Bonus for 2 and 4 worn armor pieces of the same material. Bonus and strength per material with the arrow.
gearbalance.options.trident.tip: Prismarine crystals, a nautilus shell and sticks make a trident. Applies after the world is loaded again.
gearbalance.options.chainmail.tip: Craft chainmail armor from iron chains. Applies after the world is loaded again.
gearbalance.profiles.title: Profiles
gearbalance.profiles.name: Profile name
gearbalance.profiles.save.tip: Saves all current settings in this profile: gear values, materials, set bonuses and every function with its switches and values. Overwrites the profile.
gearbalance.profiles.load.tip: Replaces the current values with this profile.
gearbalance.export.tip: Saves the current settings as a file in config/gearbalance/profiles/. You can share the file or put it into a modpack.
gearbalance.import.tip: Loads a file from config/gearbalance/profiles/. Just drop files from others into that folder.
gearbalance.import.title: Import settings
gearbalance.import.failed: The file could not be read, nothing was changed.
gearbalance.profiles.save.confirm.title: Overwrite "%s"?
gearbalance.profiles.save.confirm.messag: The profile is replaced by the current settings. What was saved in it before is lost.
gearbalance.profiles.clear.confirm.title: Clear "%s"?
gearbalance.profiles.clear.confirm.messa: All settings in this profile are deleted. This can't be undone.
gearbalance.import.file.tip: Click to load. Replaces the current settings, you'll be asked first.
gearbalance.import.delete.confirm.title: Delete "%s"?
gearbalance.import.delete.confirm.messag: The file is deleted for good. This can't be undone.
gearbalance.import.delete.failed: The file could not be deleted.
gearbalance.preset.balanced.tip: Vanilla without its weak spots: gold lasts much longer, leather twice as long, netherite gets more durability, toughness and mining speed. The sword is the main weapon and gets stronger and faster with every material (netherite 12 damage, speed 1.8). Spears hit slowly but hard (netherite 16.5 damage), with vanilla speed and reach. Axes keep their vanilla damage and speed. Plus trident, chainmail and rabbit hide recipes, no "Too Expensive!", zombie leather and better endgame loot. No level requirements.
gearbalance.preset.progression.short: Every tier has to be earned
gearbalance.preset.progression.tip: Like VanillaPlus, plus level requirements (copper 5 up to netherite 35), armor weight (iron the heaviest, netherite the lightest) and set bonuses for every material.
gearbalance.preset.challenge.tip: A quarter less durability, anvil repairs only 15 %, level requirements up to 50, more weight, set bonuses half as strong and a shield that blocks only 80 % and is disabled for 7 seconds after an axe hit.
gearbalance.load.confirm.title: Load "%s"?
gearbalance.load.confirm.message: Your current settings are replaced. Anything you haven't saved in a profile of your own is lost. Gear values apply after a restart, recipes after reloading the world, everything else at once.
gearbalance.restart.title: Restart needed
gearbalance.restart.message: The new values only apply after restarting Minecraft. Quit the game now? Your world will be saved, then simply start Minecraft again.
gearbalance.config.column.level.tip: Experience level that must have been reached at least once. Until then armor can't be worn, tools mine like the bare hand and weapons deal no damage. Spending levels or dying does not lock anything again. Creative mode is not affected. 0 = no requirement.
gearbalance.config.column.repair.tip: How many percent of the durability one repair item restores at the anvil, for example an ingot or a diamond. 25 = vanilla.
gearbalance.config.column.weight.tip: How many percent slower the full set makes you (0 to 90, in steps of 0.1). Each worn piece counts a quarter. Leather has no weight. 0 = vanilla.
gearbalance.tab.sets.tip: Bonus per armor material: half from 2 pieces, full with 4 pieces.
gearbalance.config.column.bonus.tip: What the set bonus does. Click to change.
gearbalance.config.column.strength.tip: Bonus with 4 pieces. With 2 or 3 pieces you get half. 0 = off.
gearbalance.config.column.strength.hint: Strength with 4 pieces, half with 2 pieces.
gearbalance.set.title: %s set (%s/4)
gearbalance.bonus.reach.tip: Extra blocks of reach for mining and attacking.
gearbalance.bonus.oxygen.tip: Breathe longer under water, like Respiration.
gearbalance.bonus.burning.tip: Percent shorter burning after catching fire.
gearbalance.bonus.luck.tip: Better loot from fishing and chests.
gearbalance.config.note_materials: Level and repair apply at once, weight after a restart.
gearbalance.options.rabbit_recipe.tip: 1 leather makes 4 rabbit hides. Applies after the world is loaded again.
gearbalance.options.horse_armor.tip: Copper, iron, gold and diamond horse armor at the crafting table, in the same shape as leather horse armor (7 ingots or diamonds). Netherite horse armor already comes from the smithing table in vanilla. Applies after reloading the world.
gearbalance.options.rabbit_armor.tip: Leather armor is crafted from rabbit hides instead of leather (same pattern). Applies after the world is loaded again.
gearbalance.options.anvil.tip: On: the anvil never says "Too Expensive!". Costs above the highest cost are lowered to it (set it with the arrow). Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.anvil_max.tip: Highest cost in levels (1 to %s). Default: 39.
gearbalance.options.zombie_leather.tip: Zombies, husks, drowned and zombie villagers can drop 1 leather when they die, the chance is set with the arrow. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.zombie_leather_chanc: Chance of leather in percent (1 to %s). Default: 33.
gearbalance.options.shield_wear.tip: A shield loses durability when it blocks (as in vanilla). ON: When it is badly worn, it also blocks less damage. From "Wear starts at" the block drops slowly down to the "Minimum block" just before it breaks. The tooltip always shows the current value. For every shield, right away.
gearbalance.options.shield_wear_start.ti: From this durability left the shield blocks less (1 to 100 %). 50 = from half durability.
gearbalance.options.shield_wear_min.tip: How much the shield still blocks just before it breaks, in percent of its normal block (0 to 100). 60 = still 60 %.
gearbalance.options.loot_templates.tip: Extra chance for templates: netherite upgrade and snout in bastions, spire in end cities, ward and silence in ancient cities, bolt and flow in vaults. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.loot_materials.tip: One or two extra valuable items per endgame chest, fitting the place: gold and netherite in bastions, gold, emeralds, shulker shells and potions in the End, echo shards and amethyst in ancient cities. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.loot_no_cheap.tip: Swaps filler like bones, string, coal, arrows, bread, chains and nuggets in endgame chests for valuable loot that fits the place. In the End, iron is swapped too, among other things for potions of slow falling, healing, regeneration and strength. Books are left alone. Trial chamber supply chests stay as they are. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.loot_overworld.tip: Diamonds, golden apples and enchanted golden apples are no longer in the chests of the easy overworld places (mineshafts, temples, dungeons, strongholds, villages, shipwrecks, buried treasure, ruined portals, mansions, outposts). The Nether, the End, ancient cities and trial chambers still have them. Diamond ore, archaeology and mob drops stay as they are. Applies to chests opened from now on.
gearbalance.welcome.title: GearBalance is free
gearbalance.welcome.message: Official downloads only on CurseForge and GitHub.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.gearbalance: Values for every vanilla tool, weapon and armor piece.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.gearbalan: Set the values of every vanilla tool, weapon and armor piece, with level requirements, armor weight, set bonuses, endgame loot and ready-made presets. Smithing with upgrades and gem sockets, tailoring with padded armor and bags, new shields with parrying, titanium as endgame material, a glow for fully socketed gear and comfort, death, spawner and HUD options, each with its own switch. Free on CurseForge and GitHub.
gearbalance.hm.button.tip: Ready-made profiles that match the profiles of HardmodePlus. Only one is active at a time.
gearbalance.hm.title: HM+ Profiles
gearbalance.hm.subtitle: Matching the profiles of HardmodePlus – only one active at a time
gearbalance.hm.relaxed.tip: Like VanillaPlus: gold, leather and netherite last longer, no level requirements, no armor weight, no set bonuses.
gearbalance.hm.tougher.short: A bit more durability, slightly higher levels
gearbalance.hm.tougher.tip: Like Progression, plus 10 % more durability against the extra monsters. Level requirements 10 % higher (copper 6 to netherite 39, titanium 50). Swords and spears +0.5 damage.
gearbalance.hm.veteran.tip: 25 % more durability, level requirements 20 % higher (copper 6 to netherite 42, titanium 54). Armor weighs only 75 %, the leather set gives 12 % speed – against fast zombies and spiders. Swords and spears +1 damage.
gearbalance.hm.nightmare.short: Stronger swords and spears against armored undead
gearbalance.hm.nightmare.tip: 40 % more durability, level requirements 30 % higher (copper 7 to netherite 46, titanium 59). Armor weighs only half, swords and spears +1.5 damage against armored undead, anvil repair at least 30 %. Against sieges: copper set 12 % attack speed, iron set 5 hearts.
gearbalance.hm.realism.tip: 50 % more durability, level requirements 50 % higher (copper 8 to netherite 53, titanium 68). Swords and spears +2 damage. Hard on purpose: armor weighs as in Challenge and the shield blocks less the more worn it is.
gearbalance.options.padded_armor.tip: Craft a sewing needle (iron nugget above string). At the smithing table: needle on the left, a copper, iron, gold, diamond or netherite armor piece in the middle and the matching leather piece on the right make a padded piece. The needle loses one use each time (how many it has is set with the arrow). It protects against cold like leather armor. At the grindstone (piece alone in one slot) the button "Remove padding" takes it off again, enchantments stay, the leather is lost. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.options.leather_patch.tip: At the crafting table: damaged leather piece + leather + thread + sewing needle give the piece back 25 % of its durability. The needle loses one use. Thread comes from wool (1 wool = 4 thread). Pieces saved by the break protection still need the smithing table. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.options.horse_padding.tip: At the crafting table: horse armor or wolf armor + wool + thread + sewing needle give padded armor. A horse or wolf wearing it takes only half the fall damage. The needle loses one use. Thread comes from wool (1 wool = 4 thread). Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.horse_padding.name: %s (padded)
gearbalance.horse_padding.tooltip: Padded: half fall damage for the animal
gearbalance.options.upgrades.tip: 8 ingots, leather or iron chains in a ring make a compressed material (diamonds and netherite scraps with a blaze rod in the middle). At the smithing table: forge hammer on the left, leather to netherite gear in the middle, compressed material on the right gives the next level up to +3. Mace (breeze rod), trident (prismarine crystals), bow and crossbow (compressed iron ingot) work only with the diamond or netherite hammer; bow and crossbow get more arrow damage and draw faster, the trident also hits harder when thrown. The hammer loses one use each time and has to fit the material. Each level raises the values by a few percent. Wait time, hammer uses and weapon upgrade values are set with the arrow. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.upgrade.name: %1$s%2$s %3$s
gearbalance.options.sockets.tip: At the smithing table, socket chisel on the left, leather to netherite gear in the middle, amethyst shards on the right gives an empty socket. The chisel loses one use each time and has to fit the material like the forge hammer. Forge hammer on the left, gear with an empty socket in the middle and a cut gem on the right sets the gem. Every sort has a fixed bonus and fits either weapons and tools or armor and shields; you choose the sort at the first cut at the stonecutter. Ruby, sapphire and topaz drop from redstone, lapis and gold ore and lie in structure chests, aquamarine comes from diamond ore, onyx from ancient debris. At the grindstone (piece alone in one slot) the buttons choose one or more gems to remove; the gems are lost, the sockets stay. Count, cost, wait time and chisel uses are set with the arrow, chances under Loot, bonus strength under Gems. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.options.gem_return.tip: A gem removed at the grindstone comes back one cut lower with a chance (50 % by default, set with the arrow). Flawless gives cut, cut gives chipped, chipped gives nothing. Applies at once.
gearbalance.options.gem_recut.tip: At the stonecutter every gem can be recut 1:1 into another sort of the same gem and the same cut, e.g. a cut fierce ruby into a cut bold ruby. So found gems and leftovers fit together. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.gem.rough.tip: Cut it into a sort at the stonecutter (chipped)
gearbalance.gem.set.tip: Set it at the smithing table with a forge hammer
gearbalance.gem.rare_once.tip.aquamarine: Each aquamarine only once per piece (same sort and same cut)
gearbalance.gem.rare_once.tip.onyx: Each onyx only once per piece (same sort and same cut)
gearbalance.gem.recut.tip: Recut it into another sort at the stonecutter
advancements.gearbalance.root.title: GearBalance
advancements.gearbalance.root.descriptio: Improve your gear: pad it, upgrade it and set gems in it
advancements.gearbalance.padded.title: Bundled Up
advancements.gearbalance.padded.descript: Pad an armor piece at the smithing table
advancements.gearbalance.padded_set.desc: Wear a full set of padded armor
advancements.gearbalance.upgrade.title: Forged Better
advancements.gearbalance.upgrade.descrip: Upgrade a piece of gear at the smithing table
advancements.gearbalance.upgrade_max.des: Upgrade a piece of gear to +3
advancements.gearbalance.socket.title: Socketed
advancements.gearbalance.socket.descript: Cut a socket into a piece of gear
advancements.gearbalance.gem.title: Set in Stone
advancements.gearbalance.gem.description: Set a gem into a socket
advancements.gearbalance.gems_full.title: Fully Studded
advancements.gearbalance.gems_full.descr: Set three gems into one piece
advancements.gearbalance.rough_gem.title: Sparkling
advancements.gearbalance.rough_gem.descr: Find a ruby, sapphire, topaz, aquamarine or onyx
gearbalance.options.show_hints.tip: Gems show in their tooltip how to cut and set them. The bonuses are always shown. Applies at once.
gearbalance.values.ore.tip: Chance per mined ore block (deepslate too; topaz also from nether gold ore). Never with silk touch.
gearbalance.values.chest.easy.tip: Dungeon, desert and jungle temple, mineshaft, shipwreck, buried treasure, pillager outpost, large ocean ruin. Gives a ruby, sapphire, topaz or a chipped gem.
gearbalance.values.chest.medium.tip: Nether fortress, stronghold, woodland mansion, trial chamber vault. Gives a chipped or cut gem.
gearbalance.values.chest.hard.tip: Bastion, end city, ancient city, ominous vault. Gives a cut or flawless gem.
gearbalance.values.return.tip: Chance that a removed gem comes back one cut lower. Only with "Gem return".
gearbalance.values.max_sockets.tip: Most sockets a piece of this material can get (0 to 3). 0 = no sockets. Sockets already made stay when lowered.
gearbalance.values.socket_cost.tip: How many amethyst shards this socket costs at the smithing table.
gearbalance.values.gem_row.tip: Value per cut (chipped, cut, flawless), for every gem set. Percent bonuses in percent.
gearbalance.values.reset: Resets this row to the default.
gearbalance.config.section.chests.tip: Chance per chest that a gem lies in it. The harder the place, the better the cut.
gearbalance.config.uses.tip: How often the tool can be used at the smithing table before it breaks. Applies at once, also to tools you already have. Allowed 20 to 1000, levers from 1, repair kit 1 to 50.
gearbalance.config.reset_section: Resets the whole group to the default.
gearbalance.reload.title: Reload the world?
gearbalance.reload.message: You changed features with recipes. Recipes are read when the world loads. Save and load the world again now?
gearbalance.master_plan.tip: Needed for all endgame tools. Copy it at the crafting table: plan top middle, iron block below, 7 diamonds around it.
gearbalance.options.master_plan.tip: All endgame tools need a master smithing plan in their recipe: diamond forge hammer, diamond socket chisel (and so the netherite ones), diamond gem lever (additionally, in a free slot) and netherite repair kit (instead of the diamond forge hammer). It lies in chests of hard places and drops from wither skeletons and piglin brutes. Copy it at the crafting table: plan top middle, iron block below, 7 diamonds around it. Off: no plan, normal recipes. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.config.cooldown.upgrade.tip: In-game hours a piece has to wait after an upgrade. 0 = no wait.
gearbalance.config.cooldown.socket.tip: In-game hours a piece has to wait after a new socket. 0 = no wait.
gearbalance.config.plan.chests.tip: Chance per chest in bastions, end cities, ancient cities and ominous vaults.
gearbalance.config.plan.mobs.tip: Chance per killed wither skeleton or piglin brute.
advancements.gearbalance.rare_gem.title: Rare Find
gearbalance.bonus.attack_damage.desc: More damage per hit with this weapon or tool.
gearbalance.bonus.attack_speed.desc: The weapon recharges faster after a hit.
gearbalance.bonus.mining_efficiency.desc: Blocks break faster with this tool.
gearbalance.bonus.attack_knockback.desc: Hit creatures are pushed further away.
gearbalance.bonus.sweeping_damage.desc: A sword hit also strikes creatures next to the target. The value is the share of the damage these other targets take.
gearbalance.bonus.reach.desc: Blocks and creatures can be reached from further away (in blocks).
gearbalance.bonus.submerged_mining_speed: Faster mining while the head is under water.
gearbalance.bonus.luck.desc: Better loot when fishing and in chests.
gearbalance.bonus.armor.desc: More armor points: less damage from hits.
gearbalance.bonus.armor_toughness.desc: Lowers the damage from strong hits even more.
gearbalance.bonus.movement_speed.desc: Faster walking. The camera's field of view does not change.
gearbalance.bonus.max_absorption.desc: More room for golden extra hearts (e.g. from golden apples). Gives no hearts by itself.
gearbalance.bonus.step_height.desc: Higher ledges are stepped up without jumping (1 = a full block).
gearbalance.bonus.safe_fall_distance.des: Fall damage only from a greater height (in blocks).
gearbalance.bonus.burning_time.desc: You burn shorter after fire or lava.
gearbalance.bonus.oxygen_bonus.desc: Air runs out slower under water.
gearbalance.bonus.poison_resistance.desc: Poison lasts shorter. All gems in the worn armor add up, at 100 % poison has no effect.
gearbalance.bonus.frost_resistance.desc: Less freezing damage. All gems in the worn armor add up, at 100 % you no longer freeze.
gearbalance.bonus.fire_resistance.desc: Less damage from fire and lava. All gems in the worn armor add up.
gearbalance.config.drop.ore.tip: Most rough gems one ore block gives, 1 to 5. Every find gives 1 up to this value at random.
gearbalance.config.drop.chest.tip: Most gems of this cut one chest gives, 1 to 5. Every find gives 1 up to this value at random. Which cut is found where stays fixed.
gearbalance.options.keep_table_items.tip: Items in the slots of the smithing table stay there when it is closed, like the enchanting table of EnchantPlus. Breaking the table drops them.
gearbalance.stats.title: Bonuses (worn)
gearbalance.options.shields.tip: Wooden shield as the base tier (crafting table: 7 planks like the vanilla shield, without iron); the vanilla shield recipe is gone then, vanilla shields you have keep working. Shields of copper, iron, gold and diamond: wooden shield (or vanilla shield) in the middle, 4 ingots (or diamonds) above, below, left and right. Netherite at the smithing table from the diamond shield. Better material: more durability, ready to block sooner, disabled shorter after an axe hit, explosions are also blocked from further to the side. Durability, block delay, axe disable and explosion protection angle per shield are set with the arrow. The tooltip shows parry window, blocked damage, blocking angle and durability. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
advancements.gearbalance.shield.title: Shield Wall
advancements.gearbalance.shield.descript: Craft a shield of metal or diamond
advancements.gearbalance.netherite_shiel: Upgrade a diamond shield to netherite
gearbalance.options.shield_lower.tip: First person: a shield in hand is shown lower and hides less, also while blocking. How much is set with the arrow.
gearbalance.options.hand_idle.tip: First person: while standing, both hands with shield, weapon or tool move slightly, like breathing. How strong is set with the arrow. Not while walking or blocking.
gearbalance.options.pickup_display.tip: Picked up items appear as tiles next to the hotbar, with picture and count ("+12"). The newest sits right at the hotbar, older ones move outwards. The same item counts up in its tile. Default: Off.
gearbalance.config.view.pickup_rows.tip: At most this many tiles at once, 1 to 10. The oldest drop out, the screen edge is the limit.
gearbalance.config.view.pickup_scale.tip: Size of the tiles, 50 to 200 %. 100 = as big as a hotbar slot.
gearbalance.options.pickup_marks.tip: Newly picked up items sparkle in the top right of their inventory slot until you move the mouse over them once. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.pickup_right.tip: On: tiles right of the hotbar, running to the right. Off (default): left of the hotbar, running to the left.
gearbalance.options.outlines.tip: Weapons, tools and shields with every socket filled glow in the hand: a 1 px outline with colored side faces and a soft glow. Spears get the outline only, shields a frame and a glow. Settings in the "Glow" tab. Only visible to you. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.effect_flames.tip: Flames instead of the glow on diamond, netherite and titanium tools and swords. All other pieces keep the glow. Turns "Effect: shadow" off.
gearbalance.options.effect_shadow.tip: Dark smoke instead of the glow on diamond, netherite and titanium tools and swords. All other pieces keep the glow. Turns "Effect: flames" off.
gearbalance.options.glow_pulse.tip: Glow and effects slowly get brighter and darker. OFF: steady brightness. Shields never pulse.
gearbalance.options.hide_glint.tip: Hides the enchantment glint on pieces with full sockets while the glow outline is on. The glint strength of all items is set by the game itself under Accessibility.
gearbalance.menu.glow.tip: Glow of full sockets: outline, glow, effects, color, pulse and shield. Only visible to you.
gearbalance.config.glow.group.effect.tip: Glow on or off, flames or shadow instead of the glow, brightness and enchantment glint.
gearbalance.config.glow.group.outline.ti: The 1 px edge with its side faces. It is always fully opaque.
gearbalance.config.glow.group.color.tip: One shared color for outline, glow, effects and shields.
gearbalance.config.glow.group.pulse.tip: Glow and effects slowly get brighter and darker.
gearbalance.config.glow.group.shield.tip: Frame and glow around the shield plate.
gearbalance.config.glow.effect_brightnes: Opacity of glow and effects, 0 to 100 %. Default: 75 %.
How strongly outline and side faces show the color, 0 % = grey, 100 % = full color. Default: 70 %.
gearbalance.config.glow.effect_red.tip: Red part of the color, 0 to 255. Default (orange): 255 / 110 / 20.
gearbalance.config.glow.effect_green.tip: Green part of the color, 0 to 255. Default (orange): 255 / 110 / 20.
gearbalance.config.glow.effect_blue.tip: Blue part of the color, 0 to 255. Default (orange): 255 / 110 / 20.
gearbalance.config.glow.pulse_strength.t: How much darker glow and effects get while pulsing, in % of the brightness, 0 to 100. Default: 30 %.
gearbalance.config.glow.pulse_seconds.ti: Length of one pulse (bright and dark again), 1 to 10 seconds. Default: 3 s.
gearbalance.config.glow.shield_frame.tip: Brightness of the frame around the shield plate, 0 to 100 % of the outline color. Default: 70 %.
gearbalance.config.glow.shield_glow.tip: Opacity of the soft glow around the shield plate, 0 to 100 % (0 = frame only). Default: 50 %.
gearbalance.config.view.group.tooltips.t: Frames, name colors, hints, comparison and durability in tooltips.
gearbalance.config.view.group.pickup.tip: Display of picked up items next to the hotbar and the mark on new items in the inventory.
gearbalance.config.view.group.screen.tip: What you see while playing: shield, fire, hand and durability warning.
gearbalance.config.view.group.hotbar.tip: Hotbar hiding and animations of the hotbar, item name and experience bar.
Own GUI size for the inventory.
gearbalance.options.tooltip_frames.tip: Tooltips get a frame: gear in the color of its material with a chain, picture and the name in the material color, everything else a plain white frame with the name in the middle. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.fire_lower.tip: First person view: while you burn, the flames on screen are drawn lower and hide less. Set how much with the arrow.
gearbalance.options.durability_warning.t: A short sound when a worn or held item reaches the set durability left (set with the arrow). Only once, when it gets there.
gearbalance.options.compare_tooltip.tip: Item tooltip with Shift held: what the item gives more (green) or less (red) than the worn or held item. Upgrades and gems count; also durability as numbers, upgrade level, sockets and enchantments.
gearbalance.compare.title: Compared to %s:
gearbalance.options.tool_durability.tip: Shows in the tooltip of forge hammers, socket chisels, sewing needle, repair kit and gem levers how many uses are left.
gearbalance.options.durability_all.tip: Shows the durability left ("Durability: x/y") in the tooltip of all other tools, weapons, armor and shields. Applies at once.
gearbalance.config.gem.share.tip: Aquamarine and onyx give 2 bonuses. Each gets this share of the set values, 50 to 100 %.
gearbalance.config.gem.pair.tip: Gives both bonuses with the share above (already included in the values above). The base values are set at the gems with one bonus.
gearbalance.config.tailoring.needle.tip: Every tailoring function needs the sewing needle. Set here how often it can be used.
gearbalance.options.repair_kit.tip: Netherite repair kit: crafting table with a diamond forge hammer in the middle (with "Master smithing plan" the plan instead of the hammer), 4 netherite ingots above, below, left and right and 4 diamonds in the corners. Use it in the inventory like a bundle: pick the kit up and right-click a damaged piece with it (or the other way round). The piece is fully repaired, without anvil cost; the kit loses one use. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.options.gem_lever.tip: Diamond gem lever: crafting table with 1 diamond block top right, 1 iron ingot in the middle and 1 iron ingot bottom left (with "Master smithing plan" also the plan in any free slot). Netherite at the smithing table. At the smithing table put it left, a piece with gems in the middle, nothing right: the last gem comes out whole, without loss. Needs sockets.
gearbalance.options.shield_speed.tip: Better shields let you walk faster while blocking. Vanilla: 20 % of normal speed. Default: wood 20 %, copper 25 %, gold 30 %, iron 35 %, diamond 40 %, netherite 45 %, titanium 50 %. Values per shield with the arrow. Needs "Shields", applies after a restart. The vanilla shield stays unchanged.
gearbalance.config.shield_speed.tip: Walking speed while blocking, percent of normal speed (5 to 100). Applies after a restart.
gearbalance.options.parry.tip: Blocking a melee hit right when the shield is ready parries it: the attacker is pushed away, your next hit within 2 seconds deals 30 % more damage. The window is longer with better shields (wood 0.15 s to netherite 0.35 s). How far the attacker flies is set per shield with the arrow.
gearbalance.options.bags.tip: New bag slot next to the player in the inventory. A worn bag adds rows above the inventory. Made at the smithing table: sewing needle on the left, empty bundle in the middle, leather on the right. Upgrade: sewing needle, bag, on the right a copper block, iron block, gold block, diamond block, for netherite a netherite ingot; the items stay inside. Rows per bag are set with the arrow. A left click on the worn bag closes or opens its rows, a right click takes it off. The tooltip shows how full the bag is. On death the bag drops with everything in it.
gearbalance.config.bag_rows.tip: How many rows the bag adds above the inventory, 1 to 7. Slots per row are set under "Slots per row".
gearbalance.config.bag_columns.tip: 9, 11, 13 or 15 slots per bag row (other numbers are rounded down). 9 = as wide as the inventory, each step sticks out one more slot on the left and right. With fewer slots, items in the outer columns stay in the bag and come back when you set more.
gearbalance.options.inventory_scale.tip: While the inventory is open, it uses its own GUI size, for example a smaller one so bag rows and the stats panel fit on the screen. The recipe book then opens to the left of the inventory, which stays in the middle. Closing it brings back the normal GUI size; the game setting stays unchanged.
GUI size in the inventory, 1 to 8. Also used when it is larger than the normal one; at most as large as the window allows.
gearbalance.menu.functions.tip: Every feature with its switch. Click its name (arrow) to see its settings.
gearbalance.menu.gear.tip: Values of all tools, weapons, armor and other items, and the values per material.
gearbalance.menu.smithing.tip: Upgrades, master smithing plan, repair kit, smithing table and anvil.
gearbalance.menu.sockets.tip: Sockets, socket count and cost, gem return, recutting and gem levers.
gearbalance.menu.gems.tip: Bonuses of every gem sort per cut. Apply while sockets are on.
gearbalance.menu.loot.tip: Zombie leather, endgame chests and gems from ores and chests.
gearbalance.menu.view.tip: Explanations in tooltips, shield height, hand movement, durability warning, tooltips, inventory size, name color and hotbar hiding. Only for you.
gearbalance.menu.endgame.tip: Chests in end cities, bastions, ancient cities and the vaults of trial chambers.
gearbalance.menu.reset_all.tip: Sets every value and switch back to the default. You are asked first.
gearbalance.menu.reset_all.title: Reset everything?
gearbalance.menu.reset_all.message: Every feature is switched off, every value goes back to the default (items to vanilla). "Mod active" and saved profiles stay. It is saved with "Done".
gearbalance.menu.profiles.tip: Load ready-made presets, save own profiles and share settings as a file. A profile saves everything.
gearbalance.menu.note.functions: Green = saved, yellow = not saved yet. Recipes apply after the world is loaded again, shield block delay, axe disable and explosion protection angle after a restart, everything else at once.
gearbalance.menu.note.options: Green = saved, yellow = not saved yet. Applies at once.
gearbalance.menu.recipes.tip: Extra recipes: trident, chainmail armor and rabbit hide. Apply after the world is loaded again.
gearbalance.config.weapon_upgrade.tip: How many percent each upgrade level adds (0 to 50). For the trident the damage also counts when thrown. Applies at once.
gearbalance.config.section.shield_durabi: Durability of the GearBalance shields. The vanilla shield is set under Gear › Other. Applies at once.
gearbalance.config.section.shield_block_: Seconds after raising until the shield blocks (vanilla shield: 0.25). Applies after a restart.
gearbalance.config.section.shield_axe.ti: Seconds the shield can't be used after an axe hit (vanilla shield: 5). Applies after a restart.
gearbalance.config.section.shield_explos: Up to this angle from the front the shield blocks explosions (vanilla shield: 90°, 180° = from everywhere). Applies after a restart.
How many percent of the damage the shield blocks, explosions included (vanilla shield: 100 %). Applies after a restart.
gearbalance.config.parry_knockback.tip: How far a parry throws the attacker back (0 to 3). The wood value counts for the vanilla and the wooden shield. Applies at once.
gearbalance.server.locked.tip: The server sets these settings, only operators can change them. Under "Profiles" you can save them as your own profile.
gearbalance.server.save_profile.tip: Saves the settings of this server as your own profile. Your own settings stay as they are.
gearbalance.server.saved: GearBalance: server settings saved and sent to every player.
gearbalance.server.restart: GearBalance: gear values, shield values and recipes only apply after the server restarts.
gearbalance.menu.comfort.tip: Sprint fix, tool refill, break protection and gear sets.
gearbalance.options.sprint_fix.tip: ON: Letting go of the sprint key stops sprinting at once (sprint mode "Hold" only). Sprinting by tapping forward twice no longer works then. Only for you.
gearbalance.options.hotbar_hide.tip: If you don't change the slot for some seconds, the hotbar slides down out of the screen. It comes back on damage and when you are hungry. Only for you.
gearbalance.options.hotbar_hide_all.tip: OFF: Only the hotbar goes, health, armor, food and experience move into its place. ON: Everything at the bottom is hidden.
gearbalance.options.name_colors.tip: Colors the name in the tooltip: +1 green, +2 blue, +3 purple, all sockets with gems gold. Only for you.
gearbalance.options.tool_refill.tip: When a tool or weapon breaks in your hand, the same item from the inventory moves into that hand.
gearbalance.options.break_protection.tip: Valuable pieces (enchanted, upgraded or with gems) don't break, they become "damaged" at 1 durability: no values, no enchantments, can't be used (shield, bow, crossbow, trident ...), mining like with the hand. Gems can still be taken out with the gem lever or at the grindstone. Repair only at the smithing table (forge hammer + compressed material) or with the repair kit – anvil, Mending, crafting and grindstone don't help. Bow and crossbow: compressed leather; trident, mace, turtle helmet: compressed diamond; elytra: compressed phantom membrane (8 phantom membranes). Wooden and stone tools, wooden shields, shears, flint and steel and fishing rod break as usual. Recipes apply after reloading the world.
gearbalance.options.loadouts.tip: Three buttons to the left of the inventory. Shift + click saves the 4 worn armor pieces (replaces the set), Ctrl + click deletes the set, click puts the set on again (the pieces must be in the inventory).
gearbalance.options.day_night.tip: Own length of day and night in the overworld, in real minutes. Applies on the server for all players. Set how long with the arrow.
gearbalance.config.comfort.day_night.tip: Minutes for the day and for the night (with dusk and dawn), 1 to 120 each. 10 / 10 = like vanilla. Sleeping skips the night as usual.
gearbalance.options.trash.tip: Slot in the top right of the inventory. The last item put in stays there and can be taken out again. Putting in a new one deletes the old one.
gearbalance.config.view.hotbar_hide_seco: Seconds without changing the slot until the hotbar goes.
gearbalance.config.view.hotbar_damage_se: Everything stays visible this many seconds after you took damage. 0 = not at all.
gearbalance.config.view.hotbar_food.tip: While your food is at this value or below, everything stays visible (20 = full, one shank = 2). 0 = off.
gearbalance.loadout.button.tip: Click: put on · Shift + click: save · Ctrl + click: delete
gearbalance.loadout.empty: Gear set %s is empty – save it with Shift + click
gearbalance.loadout.missing: Gear set %s: %s pieces not in the inventory
gearbalance.trash.button.tip: Put an item in: it stays until you put in a new one – then the old one is deleted. Take it out with an empty hand.
gearbalance.version.mismatch: GearBalance: You have version %s, the server %s. Please use the same version.
gearbalance.command.reload: Settings read again and sent to everyone. Gear values need a restart of the server.
gearbalance.command.info: GearBalance %s – mod active: %s – changed values: %s – functions: %s
gearbalance.break_protection.name: %s (damaged)
gearbalance.break_protection.repair: Repair: smithing table with forge hammer + %s, or repair kit
item.gearbalance.smithing_template.titan: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
gearbalance.menu.titanium.tip: Titanium: a new material after netherite with ore, gear, shield and less fall damage.
gearbalance.options.titanium.tip: Titanium ore is rare in deepslate below Y 0 (only a netherite pickaxe mines it, hidden like ancient debris). The blast furnace turns it into a titanium fragment; 4 fragments + 1 netherite ingot = titanium ingot. Netherite gear + titanium ingot + titanium smithing template (rare in end city chests) gives titanium gear: about 15 % better than netherite, fire resistant, and every worn armor piece lowers the fall damage. Also titanium shield, forge hammer, socket chisel, bag and compressed titanium ingot. Ore appears in newly generated chunks, recipes after reloading the world.
gearbalance.config.titanium_fall.tip: Percent less fall damage from each worn titanium armor piece (full armor = 4 ×).
gearbalance.titanite.rough.tip: Cut it into chipped titanite at the stonecutter. Three of one cut make the next.
gearbalance.titanite.tip: Set it into a free socket at the smithing table with a forge hammer. Only one titanite per piece of gear.
gearbalance.titanium.template.tip: Upgrade netherite armor, weapons or tools to titanium at the smithing table with a titanium ingot. Enchantments, upgrades and sockets are kept. Copy it at the crafting table: template top middle, titanium ingot below, 7 diamonds around.
gearbalance.config.titanite_chance.tip: Chance per mined titanium ore (not with silk touch) that a titanite comes with it. Only with sockets.
gearbalance.config.titanite_boost.tip: How many percent stronger all other gems work in a piece with titanite: chipped / cut / flawless.
gearbalance.menu.shields.tip: New shields, shield wear and parrying.
gearbalance.menu.set_bonuses.tip: Bonuses for a full armor of one material.
gearbalance.options.hotbar_hide_armor.ti: The armor bar goes away with the hotbar instead of moving down.
gearbalance.options.hotbar_hide_xp.tip: Experience bar and level go away with the hotbar instead of moving down.
gearbalance.titanium.off.title: Turn titanium off?
gearbalance.titanium.off.message: Titanium items and gear stay and keep working. But there is no new titanium ore, no titanium recipes, no template in end city chests and no lower fall damage any more.
gearbalance.config.vanilla_shield_locked: The new shields are on: set their values under Functions › Shields. Existing vanilla shields keep these values.
gearbalance.options.armor_bar.tip: Own armor symbols above the hearts. Required for material colors and durability display. Off: vanilla symbols. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.armor_colors.tip: Each armor point in the color of the piece it comes from (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots). Dividing line between two pieces in one symbol. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.armor_cracks.tip: Cracks in the symbol from two adjustable durability limits. Default: Off.
gearbalance.config.view.armor_crack.tip: Durability left for the first cracks, 0 to 100 %. Default: 50.
gearbalance.config.view.armor_crack2.tip: Durability left for more cracks, 0 to 100 %. Default: 25.
gearbalance.options.armor_darken.tip: Symbol darker as durability goes down. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.armor_blink.tip: Symbol blinks red below the durability limit. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.armor_broken.tip: Gray symbol for pieces damaged under break protection and for pieces that just broke (3 seconds). Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.hotbar_pop.tip: Selected item briefly enlarged on switching, slightly enlarged afterwards. Default: Off.
gearbalance.config.view.hotbar_pop.tip: Largest enlargement, 0 to 50 %. Half of it permanently. Default: 25.
gearbalance.options.hotbar_low_glow.tip: Red pulsing slot below the durability limit. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.item_name_bounce.tip: Brief enlargement of the item name above the hotbar on item change. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.xp_animated.tip: Smooth filling, light on experience gain, sparks and sound on level up. Default: Off.
gearbalance.config.comfort.group.death.t: Drops, experience and gear on death. Applies to all players, set by the server.
gearbalance.options.death_pile.tip: Items and experience in one spot at the death point, no scattering. No despawn or after an adjustable time. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.death_safe.tip: Death in or above lava or in the void: drops at the last safe position (2 blocks away from lava). Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.death_xp.tip: Adjustable share of all experience points instead of vanilla (level × 7, at most 100). Default: Off.
gearbalance.config.comfort.death_xp.tip: 0 to 100 % of the experience points. Default: 80.
gearbalance.options.death_explosion.tip: Death drops take no damage from explosions. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.death_keep_armor.tip: Worn armor stays on death, with durability loss. No effect with keepInventory. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.death_keep_hotbar.ti: Hotbar items stay on death, with durability loss. No effect with keepInventory. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.death_keep_offhand.t: Off hand item stays on death, with durability loss. No effect with keepInventory. Default: Off.
gearbalance.config.comfort.death_keep_da: 0 to 50 % of the maximum durability. Never breaks from it. Default: 10.
gearbalance.options.death_point.tip: Chat message with the coordinates of the drops after death. Default: Off.
gearbalance.config.comfort.group.spawner: Drops when mining spawners. Applies to all players, set by the server.
gearbalance.options.spawner_drops.tip: Iron ingots and a chance of a chipped gem (only with sockets) when mined in survival. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.spawner_whole.tip: Netherite or titanium pickaxe with Silk Touch: the spawner drops with its mob type and spawns it again when placed. Default: Off.
gearbalance.config.view.group.hearts.tip: High resolution symbols for hearts, food, hotbar and experience bar, marking of gear hearts and saturation.
gearbalance.options.hd_hearts.tip: Heart symbols in 36 × 36 pixels, every kind (poison, wither, absorption, frozen, hardcore). Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.heart_ring.tip: Silver ring for hearts from armor, gear and set bonuses. Not for potion effects. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.hd_food.tip: Food symbols in 36 × 36 pixels, with the hunger effect. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.saturation_gold.tip: Golden drumsticks for the saturation points, counted from the right. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.hd_hud.tip: Hotbar, selection frame, off hand slot, experience bar and level number in 4x resolution. Hotbar items 25 % smaller. Default: Off.
Gliding scrolling in lists and chat.
gearbalance.options.smooth_scroll.tip: Lists (worlds, servers, resource packs, options, controls) glide to the new position. Chat scrolls line by line in short steps. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.hotbar_glide.tip: Hotbar selection frame glides to the new slot. Default: Off.
gearbalance.options.hd_armor.tip: Armor bar symbols in 4x resolution. Needs the armor bar. Default: Off.
